english:
Direct Hits with a Sniper Rifle grant a stack of Sniper's Meditation for 7 seconds. Heavy Sniper Rifle hits grant 2 stacks.

Sniper's Meditation persists through stow.

Sniper's Meditation grants increasing benefits with each stack:
• 2.8%|5.7%|9%|12%|15% increased damage
• 15|30|35|40|45 Stability
• 15|30|35|40|45 Reload Speed

source.text:
On Sniper Rifle Direct Hit:
Grant a stack of Sniper's Meditation for 7 seconds.
Heavy Sniper Rifle hits grant 2 stacks.
Sniper's Meditation Buff persists through stow.

Sniper's Meditation 
Increased Damage, Stability, and Reload Speed.
2.8% | 5.7% | 9% | 12% | 15% Increased Damage
+15 | +30 | +35 | +40 | +45 Stability
+15 | +30 | +35 | +40 | +45 Reload Speed
